articles.title: Amex introduces a framework to prevent AI agents from making unauthorized purchases
articles.summary: American Express is introducing a new framework designed to ensure AI agents only make purchases their users have authorized, potentially preventing costly mistakes and disputes as AI-powered shopping grows.
